title: Find the Longest Valid Obstacle Course at Each Position
goal: Find the longest nondecreasing obstacle course ending at every position.
strategy: Maintain the smallest possible tail for every course length. Upper-bound search places a new height after all equal tails, allowing equality to extend a course.
